Tool resolve_march with starting_region_id "white-harbor", moves to winterfell unit_ids [3], leave_power_token true? canLeavePowerToken true. We may want to leave token? Probably not necessary. Use false.

From shivering sea we have ship; could march (ship) to adjacent sea? March moves armies only land? Ships can't march. Might raid? Probably want raid from white-harbor to remove support? No enemy support nearby. Simpler: assign march to winterfell (priority high), march to white-harbor (maybe support), march to shivering sea? Might use raid there. We'll just assign march all three, starred preference avoid. Priorities: winterfell highest, white-harbor second, shivering sea third.
